source: Independent runtime modules for date markers, duration and range operations, DateEnv and formatting. The existing VPM Intl time-zone implementation is retained in zones.js. Public TypeScript contracts remain derived from 7.1.3, with corrected nullability. Upstream behavior, tests and source were inspected; this is not a clean-room claim.

omittedDependencies.temporal-polyfill: Peer dependency (^1.0.1) used for named time zones; they are read through Intl.DateTimeFormat instead.

changes: Replace the adapted runtime bundle with independently written modules scoped to the calendar APIs, preserving all named runtime exports.

Named IANA time zones are read through Intl.DateTimeFormat instead of temporal-polyfill, with Temporal's 'compatible' handling of skipped and repeated wall-clock times; the temporal-polyfill peer dependency is removed.
Years 0-99 in date arrays and ISO strings are no longer read as 1900-1999.
Time zone offsets are rounded as a whole, so a fractional minute never prints as ':60'.
The local time zone keeps milliseconds when converting a marker to a Date.
Duration parsing consumes the complete input and rejects nonfinite units.
Range inversion clips to its visible constraint and does not reorder caller arrays; epoch zero is a valid parsed range boundary.
Formatter caches detect changes to a reused context; extended-year month formatting and arbitrary-width padding work.

implementation.targetScope: Date arithmetic, duration and visible ranges, Gregorian/local/UTC/IANA zones and native/function/command formatting used by the calendar component.
implementation.retained: Existing independently written VPM Intl zone conversion and attributed upstream public TypeScript declarations.
